$comment: Central handing a *already claimed* run to the runner that polled, contract 1.11.0 (ADR 0029 sec 2). It is a one-way frame with a fresh id rather than a correlated reply, for two reasons that are facts about this repository rather than preferences: the node gateway's loop resolves its own responses, so awaiting one from inside it can only time out; and the daemon keeps no pending map for requests it originates (`connection.go` has a single switch). `run_id: null` is the 'nothing for you' answer — a shape rather than an absence, so the daemon's switch has exactly one branch to write.

delivery.$comment: Only `none` and `artifact` do anything in V2.2; the others are refused at dispatch, so they cannot reach a node.

spec.$comment: Everything the daemon needs to run it. `source` lives in here rather than beside it so there is exactly one object to validate against SEC-002's absent-fields rule.
